def find_rects(g):
    """Find closed single-color rectangle outlines: returns (color, top,left,bottom,right)."""
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[]
    # scan for each cell as top-left corner of an outline
    for c in {v for r in g for v in r}:
        seen=set()
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if g[i][j]==c and (i,j) not in seen:
                    # try to extend rectangle: find maximal run of c in row i
                    j2=j
                    while j2+1<w and g[i][j2+1]==c: j2+=1
                    i2=i
                    while i2+1<h and g[i2+1][j]==c: i2+=1
                    # check full border
                    if all(g[i][k]==c for k in range(j,j2+1)) and \
                       all(g[i2][k]==c for k in range(j,j2+1)) and \
                       all(g[k][j]==c for k in range(i,i2+1)) and \
                       all(g[k][j2]==c for k in range(i,i2+1)):
                        out.append((c,i,j,i2,j2))
                        for a in range(i,i2+1):
                            for b in range(j,j2+1):
                                if g[a][b]==c: seen.add((a,b))
    return out

def fill_rect_interiors(grid, odd_fill, even_fill):
    """Fill the interior of each closed rectangle outline: odd side -> odd_fill, even side -> even_fill."""
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for c,i,j,i2,j2 in find_rects(grid):

        for a in range(i+1,i2):
            for b in range(j+1,j2):
                g[a][b]=f
    return g
